purpose: Operationalize CI/dependency maintenance signals and route additional authoritative tungsten/publication-discovery sources surfaced while resolving the W II graph-ingestion path.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: actions/checkout v6 documentation and release history
sources.note: Official Node 24-compatible checkout action guidance. Used to move SARA CI from checkout@v4 to checkout@v6 after GitHub-hosted-runner deprecation warnings.

sources.title: actions/setup-python v6 documentation and release history
sources.note: Official Node 24-compatible Python setup action guidance. Used to move SARA CI from setup-python@v5 to setup-python@v6; the active GitHub-hosted runner version exceeded the documented minimum.

sources.title: Starlette TestClient documentation and 1.2.x release notes
sources.note: Current Starlette documentation identifies httpx2 as the TestClient backend and marks plain httpx support deprecated. Used to migrate SARA test extras to httpx2 rather than suppressing the warning.

sources.title: HTTPX2 — next-generation HTTP client for Python
sources.note: Primary implementation/source reference for the test-client dependency adopted by current Starlette. Pinning remains bounded to major version 2 for the SARA test extra.

sources.title: NIST Standard Reference Database — Journal of Physical and Chemical Reference Data Reprints
sources.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: Authoritative publication-discovery and full-text-reprint index. Use as a source-acquisition route for NIST critical compilations while preserving DOI and publication provenance.

sources.title: Tungsten vs Selenium as a potential source of kilonova nebular emission observed by Spitzer
sources.authors: Kenta Hotokezaka; Masaomi Tanaka; Daiji Kato; Gediminas Gaigalas
sources.note: Route to heavy-element spectral-synthesis/line-identification knowledge. The work constructs line lists from experimentally calibrated NIST energy levels; useful as an independent methodology example for turning level graphs into synthetic spectra, not as Glob-number evidence.

sources.title: Benchmarking calculations with spectroscopic accuracy of level energies and wavelengths in W LVII-W LXII tungsten ions
sources.authors: Chun Yu Zhang; Kai Wang; Ran Si; Michel Godefroid; Per Jonsson; Jun Xiao; Ming Feng Gu; Chong Yang Chen
sources.note: Route as a higher-charge tungsten benchmark for cross-method agreement, relativistic/QED correction accounting, and spectroscopic-accuracy validation. Keep ionization stages distinct from W II hypothesis testing.

maintenance_actions.trigger: GitHub Actions warning that Node 20-based action majors are deprecated on the hosted runner
maintenance_actions.claims_boundary: Major-version migration is based on official action documentation; CI must remain green before merge.

maintenance_actions.trigger: StarletteDeprecationWarning emitted by TestClient when plain httpx was installed
maintenance_actions.claims_boundary: No direct application imports of httpx were found in repository search before changing the test-only dependency; CI confirmation remains mandatory.

acquisition_boundary.nist_wii_full_graph: NIST documents CSV and tab-delimited ASCII output for ASD line queries, but the browsing interface used in this inquiry has not yet yielded a directly downloadable complete 2838-line W II table. Do not infer empirical degrees from the 263-level table alone.
acquisition_boundary.worldshepherd_use: SARA should treat authoritative machine-readable acquisition as a separate source-ingestion task and preserve the 2838-line holdings count, level identities, observed/Ritz values, and source references when acquired.

next_actions: Confirm the Node 24 action and httpx2 dependency migrations through the full SARA CI gate and retain any new warnings as maintenance evidence.
Continue the topology-preserving W II graph acquisition using NIST-authoritative line data rather than reconstructing missing empirical degrees from assumptions.
Apply multiple-testing correction across every predeclared species, dataset, target state, tolerance, and relational motif.
Index the kilonova line-list and W LVII-W LXII benchmark methodologies in Worldshepherd materials/model-validation knowledge with ionization-stage boundaries intact.
